title: Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS) vulnerability in Made… (CVE-2026-119490)
description: A Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Better Notifications for WP plugin by Made with Fuel Ltd. This issue allows improper neutralization of script-related HTML tags, enabling code injection. The vulnerability affects versions up to and including 1.10.1. The CVSS score is 5.3, indicating a medium severity risk. No public exploits or patches are currently documented.
